text:
oncall-bot: PAGER — metering.token_count drift detected in prod. ~12% positive delta over last 30m. Several overage flags fired. Paging SRE + billing ops.
Jess: Ack. I'm oncall, jumping in. Linking dashboards and logs.
Alice: Seen the same on shadow pipeline. Noted a deploy to metering-collector at ~14:15 UTC (rev f2a9d3). Could be related.
Ben: Billing ops here — getting customer alert noise. Which accounts are showing spikes?
Jess: Preliminary list: cust-ACME, cust-Zeta, cust-Blue. Caroline from support, can you confirm any tickets?
Caroline: Two tickets open already complaining about unexpected usage spikes. I'm drafting initial FAQ.
Maria: Running a quick reconciliation query now: 
```
select emitter_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(tokens_expected) as expected
from token_aggregates
where ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
group by emitter_id
order by tokens - expected desc
limit 10;
```
Maria: Results show emitter "proxy-v2" about 1.2x expected. Top emitters: proxy-v2, batch-collector-03.
Alice: That matches a config change in the 14:15 deploy — batching window_size moved 3 -> 5. Might increase per-request aggregation and double-count edge cases.
Dan: That was my rollout earlier to test burst smoothing. If that's the cause I can revert immediately.
Jess: Hold on revert for a second — can we mute external overage notifications before we risk more customer alerts? Ben, can you mute webhooks/notifications for impacted accounts?
Ben: Pausing overage webhooks and muting alerting for cust-ACME and cust-Zeta (global webhook paused for 30m).
Dan: Reverting batching_window change now (rolling back rev f2a9d3 -> f2a9c1).
Alice: Revert completed at 14:29 UTC. Restarting collectors and clearing local KV-caches.
Jess: Monitoring ingestion and metering diffs. Maria, can you start a targeted backfill/reconcile for the last 12h?
Maria: Backfill job started (id: backfill-1764444). ETA ~2h for full reconcile on affected emitters. Streaming partials to the dashboard.
Alice: Early numbers look like counts are trending back to baseline within two windows post-restart.
Caroline: I sent the interim customer message in tickets: "We're investigating an ingestion anomaly that inflated token counts. Overages are paused while we reconcile. We'll follow up with corrected reports within 24 hours." :white_check_mark:
Ben: Confirming no automatic billing charges have been applied yet; overage flags were pre-charge. I've opened a hold on any bill runs until reconcile completes.
Jess: Owners for post-incident actions: Alice — RCA + revert notes, Dan — deploy gating & featureflag preflight, Maria — backfill pipeline + verification, Ben — customer comms + billing holds, Caroline — customer followups.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: customer impact limited to billing flags and ticket noise; no payments charged. Continue to monitor.
Dan: I'll submit a PR to add a preflight test that simulates window_size changes against expected token aggregates.
Alice: Adding log snippet showing featureflag change for audit: 
```
[14:14:58] metering-collector: set window_size=5 via featureflag batching_window_v2 (rev f2a9d3)
```
Jess: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this pager open until backfill completes and counts re-align. If we see re-drift, escalate to SEV2. Meeting to review RCA at 16:30 UTC.
Caroline: I'll update Sales/CS and send a short status note to impacted customers once reconciliation confirms numbers.
Jess: Closing note here once the backfill finishes. Good triage, team.
